# Gerald Voisin

Gerald Voisin is a former States Member, first elected to the States of Jersey in 1999.

Gerald Voisin has participated in 1 election since 2002:

- [**2002 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/gerald-voisin#e3)

  Elected as Deputy of St Lawrence with 70.9% of the ballot.

Gerald Voisin has declared his intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Deputies Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [District 4](https://flow.je/elections/district-4). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/20/retail-head-to-seek-states-return-after-more-than-two-decades/)\]

## Election History

### 2002 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy of [St Lawrence](https://flow.je/elections/st-lawrence) (2 seats), 27th November 2002.

**Gerald Voisin was elected as Deputy of St Lawrence in 2002**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **Gerald Voisin** |  | 877 | 70.9% |
| 2 | **[Maurice Dubras](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/maurice-dubras)** |  | 743 | 60.1% |
| 3 | [Deidre Mezbourian](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/deidre-mezbourian) |  | 550 | 44.5% |
| 4 | [Peter Whorrall](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/peter-whorrall) |  | 66 | 5.3% |

1,237 ballots
